For even m=2j, positivity at arbitrarily large odd k forces v_j=cos(2jc)-cos(2ja)>=0. Geometric-series Cesaro mean v_j->0 and nonnegativity imply mean-square->0; exponential orthogonality then forces c=pi-a under strict ordering. With symmetric a,c, odd m and even k coefficients are -288 cos(mb)/(k pi)^4, so all odd multiples cos((2j+1)b)<=0; mean-square argument forces b=pi/2. Remaining exact formulas reduce coefficient positivity to cos((4j+2)a)>=-1/2. The orbit e^{2ia}(e^{4ia})^j cannot fit closed 4pi/3 arc unless root order q<=3; strict 0<a<pi/2 leaves pi/4, pi/6, pi/3, and pi/6 excluded at m=6 by negative C0=-2/5. Source 6,240 finite coefficient comparisons and independent numerical crosscheck corroborate analytical all-k result.
